name: Duniverse full-map ridge network
coordinate_reference_note: Official source-map pixel coordinates; origin at top-left; x east, y south.

generation.method: Full-map named mountain-range backbones are combined with land-constrained, anisotropic cross-curvature crest skeletons from the elevation raster. Closed summit rings and short noisy fragments are discarded; selected high summits near city divides are included as boundary anchors.
